# tessera_roles (Data Source)

The business roles of the tenant. Needs the `tessera:read` scope (the server grants `roles.read` to it, issue #719).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tessera_roles" "payments" {
  name = "Payments approver"
}

output "payments_role_id" {
  value = one(data.tessera_roles.payments.roles[*].id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only the role with this name (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The matching roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `entitlement_group_ids` (Set of Number)
- `id` (String)
- `member_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `requestable` (Boolean)
- `risk` (String)
- `status` (String) `active` or `retired`.
- `version` (Number)
